about: Bidi controls in a filled-in value (mu-152 AC9), one list for both sides: i18n.rs's tests (isolate_in, notify.rs's lines) read `clean`, the window's (bidi.test.ts, react.test.tsx) read `window`. `controls` is every character index::is_bidi_control matches, by code point; each `cases` value is filled in as written and must come out as its side's text, then isolated right to left. The core drops every control (`clean`); the window keeps an isolate pair the value opens and closes itself, since it fills text it made into other text (`window`, which differs from `clean` only there). Written with \u escapes, so the file itself holds no control.
